Players Committee card image of [[Jabba's Haven (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “If a Jabba's Palace site on table, deploy on table. The Camp is canceled. May deploy Nal Hutta from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Once per battle, may lose 1 Force; your battle destiny modifiers affect your total battle destiny instead. Once per game, may retrieve a non-[Maintenance] alien or [Independent] starship into hand. (Immune to Alter.)”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual1-Dark/large/jabbashaven.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ca1ccff62ff30b7e29da803f91a6d09ab542d803 ca1ccff] (3 October 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
